actions.action: Show state-aware reachability evidence for each scene
actions.mechanism: Explore scene-and-state pairs, separating witnessed reachability, proven unreachability, and exploration stopped at a declared limit.
actions.implementation: Configure starting states and exploration budgets; retain predecessor choices. Require complete exploration or a sound proof before labeling scenes unreachable.
actions.check: Replay reachable witnesses; inspect unreachable proof summaries and blocked conditions. Budget exhaustion must produce “not explored,” never “unreachable.”
actions.risk: Unsupported embedded code must remain unknown, not silently approximated as false.

actions.action: Distinguish progressing loops from proven player traps
actions.mechanism: Analyze state transitions within loops; repeated scene visits alone do not demonstrate a trap.
actions.implementation: Find reachable closed state regions with no terminal or outgoing transition. Display entry traces, state changes, and why every exit fails.
actions.check: Test a counter incremented each visit: exit at three must remain possible; an invariant-false exit must yield a trap proof.
actions.risk: An available exit does not prove players eventually take it.

actions.mechanism: Attach exceptions to specific findings and assumptions rather than muting all warnings about a scene.
actions.implementation: Store the finding type, affected choices, relevant conditions, author rationale, and dependency fingerprint. Keep accepted findings visible; invalidate acceptance when dependencies change.
actions.check: Accept an intentional loop and hidden scene; introduce a separate trap nearby. It must still warn, while changed exceptions require review.
actions.risk: Scene-wide exceptions could conceal unrelated defects; prohibit that scope.

actions.action: Turn inspected paths into replayable story tests
actions.mechanism: Regression traces compare expected state progression with actual execution, revealing changes that static analysis may leave unresolved.
actions.implementation: Save initial state, chosen options, expected variable values, and exit expectations from inspected paths. Replay after edits with an explicit step cap.
actions.check: Assert the three-visit loop exits on schedule; retain the impossible-exit case. Report the first divergent step and mark capped runs inconclusive.
actions.risk: Passing sampled traces does not establish global reachability or termination.
